instruction: Write an XDP program that reflects incoming Ethernet frames back out the ingress interface (XDP_TX) by swapping the source and destination MAC addresses. Pass non-matching or malformed packets.
requirements: Swap Ethernet destination MAC and source MAC addresses
Return XDP_TX for valid Ethernet frames

tests.name: test_swap_tx
tests.description: Ethernet frame should have MACs swapped and return XDP_TX

tests.name: test_arp_swap_tx
tests.description: ARP Ethernet frame should have MACs swapped and return XDP_TX

tests.name: test_udp_swap_tx
tests.description: UDP Ethernet frame should have MACs swapped and return XDP_TX

tests.name: test_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated Ethernet frame header should pass with XDP_PASS
